name: Web Awesome
summary: Font Awesome's library of framework-agnostic web components with built-in themes and CSS design tokens, and the successor product to Shoelace. The core is MIT-licensed; a paid Pro tier adds items such as patterns and a Figma design kit.

license.name: MIT License
license.notes: LICENSE.md: MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Fonticons, Inc.; npm declares MIT. Covers the open-source core only; Web Awesome Pro is sold separately (webawesome.com/purchase) and its terms were not reviewed.

notes: Replacement for australian-government-design-system (rejected: decommissioned, docs gone). Distinct verified system, not a duplicate of shoelace: Shoelace is sunset and archived, and Web Awesome is the successor product from Font Awesome with its own package (@awesome.me/webawesome vs @shoelace-style/shoelace), repo, docs site, component catalog and a paid Pro tier; the official 'Migrating from Shoelace' guide documents component-by-component changes. relatedSlugs shoelace; shoelace.replacedBy lives in another file and is not edited here. React 19+ uses the custom elements directly; wrappers for React 18 and below ship in the package (dist/react); Vue 3, Angular and Svelte have official usage guides.
